temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria has no specific prior belief that Cheryl needs help with this project; she sees Cheryl as a colleague.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Maria learns Cheryl is overwhelmed and is receptive to assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is struggling with the current workload but is open to receiving help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and compassion, with a willingness to help
temporal_state_chain.intention: Assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. Maria suggests Cheryl for a leadership role; the team leader is receptive, and Cheryl accepts and says she is ready.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has been improving with the project and may have leadership potential, but she has not yet firmly acted on that belief.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Maria sees Cheryl's improvement and confidence, and Cheryl's acceptance confirms Maria's confidence in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, committed, and willing to take on a leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Cheryl in leading the next phase of the project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria privately approaches Cheryl to check that she felt supported and not pressured. Cheryl says she was surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that her leadership suggestion may have overstepped or made Cheryl feel pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Cheryl's response reassures Maria that Cheryl did not feel pressured and values her support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl feels supported by Maria and appreciates her belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain open communication and ensure Cheryl continues to feel supported rather than pressured.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project. Cheryl accepts enthusiastically and says Maria's guidance is invaluable and that they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her honesty and support, and their relationship is intact.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Maria learns Cheryl wants to co-lead and values their partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can co-lead effectively and support each other.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria discusses future projects, and Cheryl says she would love to work together again and is excited about what they can achieve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership has grown stronger.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Cheryl confirms she wants to continue working together on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strong, and future collaboration with Cheryl is promising and mutually desired.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl on more projects in the future.
